request.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Zoom in to a close-up portrait: redraw it as only her head and the top of her shoulders, twice as big, so her face fills the middle of the square; remove the pointed hat and put a tall crown of sharp ice shards on her long white hair instead; a white fur collar on a navy robe at the bottom. Keep her pale face and big eyes, the ice colours, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
